title: How to prepare a private label supplier brief

h1: A supplier brief that supports a useful quotation
description: An illustrative purchasing checklist for product, packaging and market requirements.
outline:
Product direction and target market
Packaging options and assumptions
Documentation to confirm
Sampling and quotation checklist
notes: FICTIONAL DEMO. Review before export; no automatic main-site publishing.
faq_text:
Q: Is the example a verified supplier commitment?
A: No. All commercial details must be confirmed for each project.
Q: What should a first inquiry include?
A: Product category, destination market, packaging preference and estimated quantity.

Q: هل هذه مواصفات مؤكدة؟
A: لا. يجب تأكيد جميع التفاصيل لكل مشروع.
Q: ما المعلومات المطلوبة؟
A: الفئة والسوق والعبوة والكمية المتوقعة.
